about: Wortfilter (docs/PROMPT_Qualitaet_und_Wortfilter_2026-11-17.md, part A). ONE data file for the word rules; src/qa/wortfilter.mjs applies it to the visible text of every built page, tests/wortfilter.test.mjs runs it in npm test. Lists are Entwurf until Iva approves them. Matching: whole word, case-insensitive; a German compound counts only when it is listed itself. Page patterns: an exact path, or a path ending in * (prefix).
